essence: The verse presents tattva-differentiation as the Trika scripture's secret.
The further difference among those tattvas is declared in the Sri Trika scripture.
The range from earth to root last is divided into fifteen by the difference of shaktiman and shakti, by own nature along with anara.
Pralayakala is rudra-like, maya is ninefold, and jnakala is sevenfold again, with two differences omitted.
Shiva is not divided because he is one light-dense consciousness, unlike the mantras and mantra-lords.
